title: What makes a New Orleans band sound New Orleans
summary: St. Cyr names originality: New Orleans bands kept their own style and did not copy others.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Trying to keep up with the label style like that. Well, I was going to ask, in regard to the New Orleans style of music, to me there's always a distinct style, because I was raised otherwise and started in classical music and heard bands up north. And to me there's a definite New Orleans style. What is it, would you say, that makes the music different down there than other places? Or if you can pin it down, I don't know if you can. I mean, what would you say is really typical that makes a New Orleans band sound New Orleans?

Well, I'll tell you, for one thing, it's originality. When the bands in New Orleans played like New Orleans band, they didn't try to copy no late style or no new band that came to town, while they could appreciate the difference, the variety, but they didn't try, they had their own style and they stuck with it. And they were all together on it. Everybody felt the same way. Then the next.
